observation_not_allowed: You cannot have this node observe: members start observations only from their own User-identity devices
observation_measures: Measures probe round trips and the probe no-reply rate; the controller provides no traffic counts
observation_denied: The controller does not allow this observation: the source, target, service or path is outside what is currently permitted
observation_conflict: The controller refused: the source node has no running instance or usable execution configuration
observation_limit: The observation limit is reached (this sign-in or this network)
observation_not_found: The controller cannot find this network or node
observation_phase_failed: The source node reported a failure
observation_removed: The controller no longer keeps this observation
observation_unsupported_detail: The source node declares no path observation capability (feature:path-observation v1)
observation_renew_limit: The controller refused the renewal (observation_limit); trying again every second until the lease ends
observation_renew_denied: The controller refused the renewal: this observation is no longer permitted to you
observation_renew_conflict: The controller refused the renewal: the execution state changed
observation_counts: Replied {replied} · Timed out {timeout} · Not sent {failed} · Pending {pending}
